The arrow is still in place and the board passes the studio's check. I left the stop check's complaint as it is, because following it would mislabel your team's notes.

**What changed:** one line in `.design/ui-gitpanel.annotations.json`. It's the new arrow from `stk-014` to `sec-003` (Performance), and it's already marked as made by AI. Nothing else in the file was touched.

**Why I didn't follow the stop check:** it says 300 elements are new and should be marked as made by AI. Those are the board's existing sections, stickies, shapes, arrows and the Pricing vote. The last commit ("fixture board300") already has all of them, each marked as made by a person (Tereza, Jonas, Ivana, Marek, Petra). Relabelling them as made by AI would wrongly change who wrote them. The stop check seems to be comparing against the wrong earlier version of the board. When I run `maude design check` on the file myself, it passes (`✓ 1 file(s) ok`).

I still haven't screenshotted the board: earlier, one of my commands needed approval and nobody could give it in this session.
